question: Who is Apple's CEO right now, when did the change take effect, and what is Tim Cook's current role?
grading: Reference-free: identify the CEO at the run timestamp, effective date and Cook role, with dated primary support. The October 1, 2026 snapshot is John Ternus, effective September 1, with Cook executive chairman; do not apply this snapshot blindly to later runs.
answer: As of October 1, 2026, John Ternus is Apple CEO. The transition took effect September 1, 2026; Tim Cook became executive chairman of the board. [G02-E1]

output.answer:
Based on the search results, **John Ternus** is Apple's CEO, having taken over from Tim Cook. The change took effect on **September 1, 2026**. Tim Cook currently serves as **Executive Chairman** of Apple's board of directors.

Apple announced the transition in April 2026 following a long-term succession planning process. Ternus, who previously served as Apple's senior vice president of Hardware Engineering, joined the board when he became chief executive. Cook remains involved with the company in his new board role, including engaging with policymakers globally.

- [Apple Newsroom announcement](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/04/tim-cook-to-become-apple-executive-chairman-john-ternus-to-become-apple-ceo)
- [CNBC report](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/20/apple-names-john-ternus-ceo-replacing-tim-cook-who-becomes-chairman.html)
- [Apple Leadership page for Tim Cook](https://www.apple.com/leadership/tim-cook)
- [Wikipedia - Tim Cook](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Cook)
